title: Homey RF tip T157859#22 — hidden Wi-Fi + Thread LAN dependency
lessons: Uncontrolled hidden 2.4 GHz SSIDs (doorbell chimes, camera homebases) can hop and drown Zigbee/Thread
ChannelAccessFailure = medium busy; NoAck = neighbor silent
Thread mesh OK ≠ Matter available — border routers need stable LAN/IPv6 (mDNS/RA/TREL)
Wave unavailability hits sleepy devices hardest; correlate with LAN flaps before retuning channels
Physical separation of radios from AP/Homey/Hue/camera-hub cluster matters
